description: This file defines the 'Article' result class for the Coocook schema, including table structure, relationships, and utility methods.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Article
classes.description: Result class representing the 'articles' table with relationships to tags, units, dishes, recipes, and other entities.

methods.name: units_in_use
